summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Branded Storefront / Admin Customization Panel. 11/11 backend tests pass (public + admin endpoints, partial-patch deep-merge, auth guards). Frontend E2E confirms HomePage hero/sections render from storefront data, admin page loads with all sections & testids, save triggers PATCH, live CSS vars (--brand-primary, etc.) update on document.documentElement and propagate to public HomePage after refreshStorefront(). Discard reverts unsaved changes. SEO title applied via document.title. Defaults restored at end.
critical_code_review_comments: useStorefront caches settings in a module-level variable; on admin save refreshStorefront() updates it and notifies listeners — correct. No action needed.
Backend _get_storefront() deep-merges one level only; if nested objects gain sub-dicts later, merge will need to be recursive. Not an issue today but flag for future.
AdminStorefront.js save() sends the entire state (not a diff). Fine given deep-merge on server, but means any stale fields roundtrip. Acceptable for a settings doc.

Color hex input accepts arbitrary text without validation — a malformed value would silently no-op the CSS var (shade() returns hex as-is). Consider adding a regex check / fallback UI in the admin form.
seed_data_creation: None. During tests, storefront doc was patched then restored to defaults (colors primary/secondary/accent, tagline, hero.eyebrow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Storefront endpoints live under /api/storefront/* (public) and /api/admin/storefront/settings (admin, cookie auth). Admin page route: /admin/storefront. CSS vars confirmed live at document.documentElement after save + refreshStorefront(). test_storefront.py covers GET/PATCH/auth/deep-merge/public-reflection/restore. All storefront defaults are restored. If testing side-effects on colors, remember to PATCH back to primary #6E1C1E, secondary #D4A456, accent #1E3A2F.
